Sophia: Hey team — PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/9482 ready to land but CI stuck on `integration/queue` (flaky DB tests). Need a rebase slot before the canary window opens at 10:00 PT. Can someone grab a slot or advise timing? cc @Raj @Lina

Raj: I can take a rebase slot at 09:30 PT. If the tests are flaky we should avoid landing during the canary unless we have a kill-switch.

Lina: FYI CI shows `integration/db-timeout` failing on latest run. Might be the new fixture in my PR but unsure. I'll add a retry in the test.

Aaron: If you want me to hold it I can queue it into the pre-canary batch at 09:45. Will need approvals from @Sophia and @Lina first. :thumbsup: 

Sophia: Approved from me. Lina, once you push the test tweak ping here and I'll rebase.

ci-bot: build queued for PR #9482 — integration/queue (run 5). ETA ~25m. https://ci.redwood.internal/job/9482

Lina: Pushed fix and updated the test to use `db_test_fixture_v2`. Pushing now.

Sophia: Rebased and triggered `/retest` — tracking in the job.

ci-bot: integration/queue now running for PR #9482 — run 6.

deploy-bot: Reminder: canary window 10:00-10:30 PT. Any merges during that window will trigger an auto-canary deploy unless flagged `no-canary`.

Raj: If run 6 is green we'll land at 09:50 and hold canary flag off. If it flakes, we'll skip and move to next business day.

Aaron: Sounds good. I'll keep watch and ping when it's green. :eyes:
